triggers.name: new_events
triggers.title: New/updated/deleted events
triggers.help: The Events API lets your application learn about activity in Egnyte. This means you can find out what has happened since a given moment in time, letting your application respond or react to activity. Currently, this API is in beta and is limited to file system and notes activity. By default, the tri…

input.name: ___poll_interval
input.label: Trigger poll interval
input.hint: How frequently to check for new events. Defaults to {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes if left blank. Minimum value allowed is {{authUser.membership.min_poll_interval}} minutes. Learn more …

input.name: event_types
input.label: Event types
input.hint: Select the event types you want to be notified.

input.name: folder
input.label: Folder
input.hint: Scope requests to a given folder. When folder is specified, it return events that have occurred at this path (including events inside subfolders).

input.name: event_from
input.label: Retrieve events from beginning
input.hint: Select Yes to fetch events from the beginning of time. Otherwise, it retrieves events from recipe start time if No or Unselected .

actions.name: __adhoc_http_action
actions.title: Custom action
actions.help: Build your own Egnyte action with an HTTP request. The request will be authorized with your Egnyte connection.

input.name: mnemonic
input.label: Action name
input.hint: Give this action you're building a descriptive name, e.g. create record, get record

input.name: verb
input.label: Method
input.hint: Select HTTP method of the request

actions.name: copy_or_move_file
actions.title: Copy or move file
actions.description: Copy or move file in Egnyte
actions.help: Copy or move only one file in Egnyte.

input.name: path
input.label: File path
input.hint: Select path of file.

input.name: destination_path
input.label: Destination folder
input.hint: Select destination path.

input.name: file_name
input.label: Destination file name
input.hint: To rename a file, provide a new file name along with file extension. Example: Sample.txt

input.name: permissions
input.label: Permissions
input.hint: Determines how permissions of copied file or folder are derived. Allowed values are: keep_original, inherit_from_parent . If neither is specified, default behavior is to use the workgroup settings con…

input.name: entry_id
input.label: Entry ID
input.hint: Specifies the entry ID of the file version to copy.Entry ID for a specific version of the desired file. If none is specified then the latest file version for the file will be copied.

input.hint: Determines how permissions of copied file or folder are derived. Allowed values are: keep_original, inherit_from_parent . If neither is specified, default behavior is to use the workgroup settings con…

actions.name: create_folder
actions.title: Create folder
actions.help: Creates a new folder in Egnyte.

input.name: parent_folder
input.label: Folder
input.hint: Select path to create new folder.

actions.name: download_file
actions.title: Download file from selected folder
actions.help: Download file contents from selected folder in Egnyte.

input.name: file_path
input.label: File path
input.hint: Select path of file.

input.name: chunk_size
input.label: Chunk size
input.hint: File contents will be transferred in chunks of this size. Enter the size with the unit, Eg. 50KB. Valid units are 'B', 'KB', 'MB'. Default chunk size is 10MB . Minimum is 32KB and maximum is 10MB . Us…

actions.name: get_event_details
actions.title: Get event details
actions.description: Get file system or note event details in Egnyte

input.name: object_detail
input.label: Event object URI
input.hint: The object uri from the Event trigger output.

input.name: path
input.label: Folder path
input.hint: Select path of folder.

input.name: path
input.label: File path
input.hint: Select path of file.

input.name: list_content
input.label: List content
input.hint: For folders, this option determines whether the contents of the folder (files and subfolders) are included in the response. Default: Yes . For files, when Yes , this will return a list of all of the v…

input.name: allowed_link_types
input.label: Allowed link types
input.hint: If Yes , then show allowed_file_link_types, allowed_folder_link_types fields, and allow_upload_links fields. Default: No .

input.name: perms
input.label: Permissions
input.hint: If Yes , the response includes a permissions key for the folder that lists the different users and groups who have permissions along with their permission level. Default: No .

input.name: include_perm
input.label: Include permission level
input.hint: If Yes , the response returns the current user's permission level on the folder and subfolders. Default: No .

input.name: query
input.label: Search string
input.hint: Provide search string to find. String length should be between 3-100 . For file, it also searches in the file content.

actions.name: upload_file
actions.title: Upload file
actions.help: Upload file to a selected folder in Egnyte.

input.name: folder_path
input.label: Folder
input.hint: Select path to upload file.

input.name: file_name
input.label: File name
input.hint: Provide file name that you want to upload. Example: Contacts.csv

input.name: streaming_upload
input.label: Streaming upload?
input.hint: Select Yes , if file size is over 100MB. Minimum file size for streaming should be over 20MB. Defaults to regular file upload.
